inputs.prompt: Retro Cartoon Graffiti EDM Party Poster for "TALIEU & FRIENDS" This design features a playful DJ narrative with a striking color palette of green, pink, and white. 1. Visual Focus The core visual centers on a cartoon green crocodile DJ, rendered with a green background and pink line-art graffiti texture. The main scene depicts two crocodiles operating a DJ deck, accented with musical notes to emphasize the relaxed and witty atmosphere of the party. 2. Information Elements The details are organized with a clear hierarchy: the title "TALIEU & FRIENDS" stands out in bold white text. It also lists the date "20TH SEPTEMBER 2025 1PM-10PM", the lineup (Archie Briant), and the venue "93 FEET EAST 150 BRICK LANE, LONDON, E1 6QL". 3. Color & Texture Dominated by a green base, pink graffiti outlines, and white typography, the design overlays cartoon figures and DJ elements to recreate the retro, playful texture of 90s underground EDM party posters. It perfectly blends the humor of the cartoon crocodiles, the dynamic energy of electronic music elements, and the visual tension of the contrasting colors—capturing both the carnival spirit of the party and the laid-back vibe of retro graffiti.

inputs.text:
Style: retro cartoon graffiti poster with a gritty 1990s underground EDM party aesthetic. The image is a single continuous event-poster design dominated by deep green, hot pink, and white, with rough spray-paint texture, distressed ink, splatters, halftone dots, drips, and hand-drawn outlines. Across the upper center, the main title appears in oversized bold white block lettering with black shadowing and worn speckled texture, reading "TALIEU". Directly beneath it, a smaller but still prominent hot-pink brush-script line reads "& FRIENDS", underlined with energetic paint strokes. Around the headline are small decorative symbols including stars, lightning bolts, musical notes, crown-like doodles, and dripping graffiti marks in pink and white.

In the middle of the poster, two cartoon crocodile DJs occupy the main scene behind a DJ setup. The left crocodile is larger, bright green with darker green spots, a cream-colored belly, black sketchy outlines, rounded eyes, and an open smiling mouth showing teeth and tongue. It wears dark sunglasses with reflective highlights and a backward hot-pink cap. Its hands rest on the DJ equipment, one near the mixer controls and the other near the turntable, suggesting active performance. The right crocodile is slightly smaller, also green with darker spots and a cream belly, wearing dark sunglasses and a backward hot-pink cap. It smiles broadly with an open mouth and places its hands on the decks as if scratching or mixing. Both characters have playful, mischievous expressions consistent with the humorous party-poster tone.

The DJ equipment spans the lower middle area, drawn in a detailed illustrated style with turntables, mixers, knobs, sliders, buttons, cables, and glowing accents. Pink and green indicator lights add energy to the setup, while the crocodiles’ hands interact with the controls. Musical-note icons float around them, especially to the left and right sides, reinforcing the electronic music theme. Behind the crocodiles, the background remains a textured green field with layered graffiti outlines, paint splashes, rough brush marks, and scattered ink-like distressing.

Below the DJ scene, the event date and time are centered in large white uppercase text reading "20TH SEPTEMBER 2025 1PM-10PM". Under that, the lineup appears in hot-pink uppercase lettering reading "ARCHIE BRIANT". Near the bottom, the venue information is set in large white uppercase type reading
